pregame.whyWatch: Jamal Roberts (MIZ RB, Sr): 828 rush yds on 147 carries, 8 TD, 84 rec yds. A workhorse at 24.5 carries a game. Watch his burst and ball security in the fourth quarter.
pregame.pressurePoint: No unit has a clear edge. The closest thing to a swing: missouri run game vs ole miss run defense. Missouri is No. 103 in rush success rate (40%) and Ole Miss is No. 126 against the run (48%). Strength on strength. Neither side has shown it can impose the run on a unit this good. The first stuffed series tells you who blinks. First quarter: who wins first contact.

edges.why: Missouri is No. 30 of 138 at the line of scrimmage (2.48). Ole Miss ranks No. 97 in line yards per carry (2.94). A clear edge, the kind that shapes a game plan. Missouri should hold the line of scrimmage. Ole Miss's runs will need the second level to break.

Ole Miss is No. 27 of 138 in passing-downs success (37%). Missouri ranks No. 70 on passing downs (28%). A real edge, not a lock. Ole Miss converts the long downs Missouri needs to win. A third-and-8 is not a stop here.
